name: Neoma
source:
An ambitious woman with sadistic inclinations. It is to her that you have to constantly make reports on the state of affairs.
She possesses outstanding magical potential and likes to use it to punish the guilty. Most likely, her teachers were to harsh, which damaged her psyche.
She demands manic loyalty from her subordinates, but if you earn her trust, you might see some great benefits or rewards.
